methods.label: Midsegments along the diagonals
methods.explanation: Draw \(AC\) and \(BD\). By the midsegment theorem, \(EF=HG=AC/2=4\) and \(FG=EH=BD/2=3\). The perimeter is \(2\times(4+3)=14\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 triangle midsegments in the triangles formed by the quadrilateral's diagonals.
